_doc: Ahmedabad OSM layers for scripts/fetch-osm-layers.ts. Water bodies use a box wider than the AMC limit (22.91-23.14N, 72.45-72.70E from the 2024 ward map) so the lakes on the urban edge, Bopal, Ghuma, Ognaj and the Narmada canal crossing, are not cut off at the boundary - the Pune bbox bug.

water-bodies._note: Drains and wastewater are conveyance, not water bodies. The Sabarmati's riverfront channel is mapped as water=river and stays in: it is the city's largest open water.

rivers._note: Basin-scoped so the Sabarmati runs from Dharoi (24.0 N) to its confluence below Vautha (22.6 N): the river's quality stations sit along that whole reach and the story is the change inside the city. The Kharicut canal is checked before the Khari river because its name contains 'khari'. The Narmada Main Canal is drawn only where it crosses this box: it is the city's water source, not a river of the city.

localities._note: Places joined to AMC's own 2020 ward layer; anything outside the 48 wards is dropped. Written as {localities: [...]} so the file keeps its NVDM envelope across refreshes.
